name: ArtifactsBench
intro: ArtifactsBench 针对大型语言模型生成的动态交互式视觉作品提出评测基准，弥补传统基准只关注算法正确性而忽视视觉质量和交互性的不足。该框架自动渲染生成作品并通过时间序列截图捕捉动态行为，实现多模态自动评测。
build_method: 多源候选聚合, 两阶段去重, 专家重写与难度校准, 检查表构建, MLLM裁判与人工验证
metric: Checklist-guided Score, Pair ACC, WebDev Arena Rank Alignment
modality: 文本, 图像, 代码, 多模态
eval_feature: 动态交互, 多模态, 自动化
build_method_en: Multi-source Aggregation, Two-stage Deduplication, Expert Rewriting and Difficulty Calibration, Checklist Construction, MLLM Judging and Human Validation
intro_en: ArtifactsBench proposes an evaluation benchmark for dynamic interactive visual works generated by large language models, addressing the limitation of traditional benchmarks that focus solely on algorithmic correctness while neglecting visual quality and interactivity. The framework automatically renders generated works and captures dynamic behaviors through time-series screenshots, enabling multimodal automatic evaluation.
metric_en: Checklist-guided Score, Pair ACC, WebDev Arena Rank Alignment
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2507.04952 sections on candidate aggregation from expert showcases, SVG/web snippets, case studies, and screenshots, automated filtering, MinHash/semantic/visual deduplication, expert and LLM prompt rewriting, 30/40/30 difficulty calibration, 10-dimension checklist calibration, Playwright sandbox execution with three staged screenshots, checklist-guided MLLM-as-Judge scoring, human validation, and WebDev Arena alignment.
